name: Checkbox
title: Checkbox
summary: A 20px checkbox with 6px corners for single yes/no choices, and full-width `.check` row cards for choosing several options from a short list.
whenToUse: Single inline checkbox (`.fm-inline` + `.fm-check`): consent and one-off choices ("I agree to the Terms", "Send me prayer updates").
Check rows (`.check`): pick any number from 2–7 options that each need a line of explanation (partnership types, newsletter topics).
8 or more options, or a searchable list: use MultiSelect.
Only one may be picked: use Radio. A setting that takes effect at once: use Switch.

props.name: children
props.description: Label content. A short sentence for the inline form, a short noun for a row card. May contain links (they stay focusable).

props.name: card
props.description: Render as a full-width `.check` row card with a title (`children`) and an optional `description`.

props.name: description
props.description: One-line explanation under the title of a row card (`.hint` style). Also used as an inline hint after the label.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Show the indeterminate state (a dash) and set `aria-checked="mixed"`. Say what it summarises in the label ("3 of 12").

props.name: error
props.description: Error message shown directly under the checkbox. Sets `aria-invalid="true"` and links it with `aria-describedby`. For a group, use `CheckboxGroup error` instead.

props.name: label
props.description: Label next to the box. May contain a nested `<Text tone="link">`.

props.name: description
props.description: One-line explanation under the label. Only shown in the `card` variant.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Shows a dash and reports `mixed` to screen readers. Use with a summary, e.g. "3 of 12".

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the next checked value.

props.name: variant
props.description: `inline` is a 44dp row for consent; `card` is a bordered row for choosing among 2 to 7 options.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the box invalid (error border and fill). Put the message in a `CheckboxGroup` or beside the control.

variantNotes: Unchecked: 1.5px `rgba(0,0,0,.4)` border on white; hover darkens to black.
Checked: `--horizon-blue` fill with a white tick.
Indeterminate: blue fill with a white dash. Set `el.indeterminate = true` in script (or `.fm-mixed` for static specs) and `aria-checked="mixed"`.
Disabled: `--gray-100` fill, `--gray-300` border; label in `--gray-600` via `.fm-inline.fm-disabled`. Checked-disabled fills `--gray-300`.
Error: `aria-invalid="true"` gives an `--error` border on `--error-bg`; add one `.err` line under it, linked with `aria-describedby`.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Always wrap the box and its text in one `<label>`, so the text is clickable.
Use a real `<input type="checkbox">`; never a styled div.
Do not pre-check consent or marketing boxes.
Group related check rows in a `<fieldset>` with a `.fm-legend` question.
Mark optional boxes "(optional)" in `.hint` style; required consent gets an error if left unticked on submit.
Checked state is Horizon Blue only; never use green for "checked".
Keep rows at least 44px tall; do not shrink the box below 20px.

accessibility: Error text is linked with `aria-describedby` and repeated in the form's validation summary.
Indeterminate state must also set `aria-checked="mixed"` and say what it summarises ("3 of 12").
Links inside the label (Terms) stay focusable and keep their underline.
content: Consent: "I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy".
Opt-in: "Send me partner news and prayer updates (optional)".
Row titles are short nouns ("Broadcast partner"); the hint says what it means in one line ("Carry scripture on your HD channel").
Error: "Please accept the Terms to continue."
